finalLens.title: The Plan Names Names
finalLens.intro: The group chat goes quiet after the easy plan, and you notice who is expected to keep things smooth.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can keep the mood steady without pretending the plan works for everyone.
finalLens.deeper_read: When a friend reaches for a quick peace, you may hold back the part that would change the plan, then remain the reliable one who absorbs the unevenness. Saying what you can offer, and inviting one person into something more definite, lets your steadiness become shared rather than silently spent.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment a broad plan assumes you will be available, while nobody asks what works for you.
finalLens.move: Send one friend a specific invitation with a time, a place, and the amount of energy you have.

finalLens.title: Bring It Forward
finalLens.intro: The disagreement stays unresolved while you hold back, waiting until you can explain it without heat.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can stay calm for so long that the real issue never gets said.
finalLens.deeper_read: You notice the tone shift, replay the exchange, and keep returning to the part that crossed a line. Your steadiness can make room for repair, but only once you separate what happened from what you think it meant and say what would make it right.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself revisiting a message while the one specific change you need remains unstated.
finalLens.move: Name the moment that affected you, then ask for one concrete change before responding further.

finalLens.intro: You mention that the second pass keeps sending you back, then pause before starting it again.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can keep doing it, but I can also admit this part keeps getting in the way.

finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you begin the same correction twice without saying that the sequence is not working.
finalLens.move: Move one part of the sequence earlier or later, then notice whether the return trip disappears.

mergedCandidate.move: Move one repeated task earlier or later today, and say aloud whether the change eases the day.
